content: The current production environment has persistent correlated resource and service issues: 97% disk usage, 16Gi/23Gi memory usage, 16Gi/23Gi swap usage, inactive phone-sync-import.timer, unreachable ADB device 100.87.37.3:5555, and a never-executed weekly-review cron job (last_run_at=null, repeat.completed=0), all of which are linked to the recurring phone-sync-failure pattern and are priority remediation targets for the autonomous task workflow.
